write.greet.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Greets the person given as the first argument.
echo "Hello, $1!"
echo "You gave $# arguments: $@"
echo "This script is $0"
write.check.sh:
#!/bin/bash
if [ -z "$1" ]; then
  echo "usage: check.sh FILE"
  exit 1
fi
if [ -f "$1" ]; then
  lines=$(wc -l < "$1")
  echo "$1 has $lines lines"
else
  echo "$1: no such file"
  exit 2
fi
write.backup.sh:
#!/bin/bash
for f in "$@"; do
  cp "$f" "$f.bak"
  echo "saved $f.bak"
done
write.countdown.sh:
#!/bin/bash
n=$1
while [ $n -gt 0 ]; do
  echo $n
  n=$((n - 1))
done
echo "Go!"

solution: for i in $(seq 1 7); do touch "week/day$i.txt"; done

hints.tr: Sayıları `$(seq 1 7)` ya da `{1..7}` verir. Döngünün gövdesi: `touch "week/day$i.txt"`.
hints.en: `$(seq 1 7)` or `{1..7}` gives the numbers. The body of the loop: `touch "week/day$i.txt"`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı (komutları sırayla yaz):

```bash
mkdir week
for i in $(seq 1 7); do touch "week/day$i.txt"; done
```
hints.en:
The full solution (type the commands in order):

```bash
mkdir week
for i in $(seq 1 7); do touch "week/day$i.txt"; done
```
